content.subject: URGENT: Your account will be suspended
content.body: Dear valued customer, We detected unusual activity on your account. Click here immediately to verify your identity or your account will be permanently suspended within 24 hours.

scenarios.reason: Domain uses '0' instead of 'o' (amaz0n). Creates false urgency. Legitimate companies don't threaten suspension.

content.body: Someone tried logging into your account from a new device. If this wasn't you, secure your account now: bit.ly/ig-secure-2024

scenarios.reason: Uses a URL shortener (bit.ly) instead of official Instagram links. Real Instagram uses in-app notifications.

content.subject: Dependabot alert: security vulnerability
content.body: Dependabot found 1 security vulnerability in your repository 'devnest-web'. View details at github.com/yourrepo/security

scenarios.reason: Legitimate GitHub domain. Provides specific repo name. Links to official GitHub security page.

content.body: Congratulations! You've been selected for a high-paying internship. Fill this form with your bank details to receive the joining bonus: forms.gl/xyz123

scenarios.reason: Legitimate companies never ask for bank details upfront. Too-good-to-be-true offers are red flags.

content.subject: Semester Exam Schedule - Fall 2024
content.body: Dear students, Please find attached the examination schedule for the upcoming semester. Visit the official portal for more details.

scenarios.reason: Uses official college domain (.edu.in). Professional tone. No urgency or suspicious requests.

content.visual: Looks like Netflix login with logo

scenarios.reason: Domain uses capital 'i' instead of lowercase 'L' in Netflix. Classic lookalike domain attack.

content.context: QR code on a poster: 'Scan to win iPhone 15 - Limited time only!'

scenarios.reason: Unverified QR codes can lead to malicious sites. No legitimate organization info. Too-good-to-be-true prize.

content.body: Reminder: Tomorrow's workshop on Web Security starts at 3 PM in Lab 201. Bring your laptop!

scenarios.reason: Simple event reminder. No links or suspicious requests. Specific venue details.

content.subject: You won $50,000 scholarship!!!
content.body: Dear Student, CONGRATULATIONS! You have been randomly selected to receive our $50,000 scholarship. Send us your Aadhar card, bank statement, and PAN card to claim your prize NOW!!!

scenarios.reason: Gmail address (not official). Excessive punctuation. Asks for sensitive documents. Unrealistic prize.

content.body: Your WhatsApp will expire today. To keep your account active, verify here: wa-verify.tk

scenarios.reason: WhatsApp accounts don't expire. Suspicious .tk domain. Creates false urgency.
